analysis: Read-only wallet/launch co-occurrence and outcome-selected curve-reserve collapse exploration. No backtest, replay, PnL, RPC, or source edits.

fee_payer_evidence.definition: The exact fee_payer field on a successful curve-buy transaction; reuse identifies a transaction payer only, not wallet funding/common ownership.

fingerprint_evidence.field_source: The repository v1 receipt route-config fingerprint derives from instruction/program/account structure; unit test says dynamic accounts and route data values are excluded. A matching hash is a coarse transaction-shape match, not actor identity.

global_scan.buyer_denominator: Unique user addresses on successful supported-SOL buy events where user != event.creator. Target all-participant cohort includes creator and sell-only users, but overlap on another mint requires an outside buy.
global_scan.deduplication: One decoded receipt row per Solana signature; duplicate-signature rows are skipped after counting. Target-only frozen set is independently matched by signature.
global_scan.launch_boundary_definition: Earliest observed noncreator supported-SOL buy per mint, not authenticated creation. Pre-target records use event_timestamp strictly less than target first-event second; after-target new mints use earliest outside buy strictly greater; same-second addresses are shown separately.
global_scan.reserve_rule: max observed rsol_raw >=10 SOL; last observed rsol_raw <=1 SOL; no supported curve event had rtokens_raw == 0
global_scan.successful_event_definition: Repository decode_observation rejects metadata errors and requires successful Pump invocation ancestry before serializing ReceiptObservation (src/bot/pump_receipt_decoder.rs); only supported_sol_quote curve events counted.
global_scan.virtual_price_rule: vsol_raw / vtokens_raw reserve ratio; max-to-last is a diagnostic percentage, not executable finite-size pricing.

limitations: Target cohorts are selected from one target mint after observing its completed receipt history; this is targeted exploratory discovery, not a population-validated detector or causal rule.
Observed mint boundaries can begin after actual creation if collection missed genesis. A low last curve reserve is an observed reserve state, not proof of fraud, manipulation, or irrecoverability.
rtokens_raw==0 is excluded as curve completion/migration; absence of zero does not authenticate post-migration venue or prove the token cannot recover.
The reserve ratio uses observed event snapshots; no RPC, holder balances, transfer tracing, full wallet-funding graph, migrated AMM continuation, replay, or PnL was performed.
Post-target activity is hindsight; even pre-target appearances are conditioned on retrospective target-cohort membership.

Target-creation and approximate-entry cutoff views use strict event_timestamp < cutoff second; same-second events are excluded because receipt timestamps have one-second resolution. The approximate entry time is not an exact target trade execution timestamp.

outcome_selected_curve_collapse_candidat.interpretation: Outcome-selected observed reserve collapse candidates only; not a fraud/rug verdict. Curves completing with rtokens_raw==0 are excluded as likely migration/completion.
outcome_selected_curve_collapse_candidat.rule: max observed rsol_raw >=10 SOL; last observed rsol_raw <=1 SOL; no supported curve event had rtokens_raw == 0

repeated_first20_pairs.interpretation: Descriptive co-occurrence/order only; no shared ownership or malicious coordination inferred.
repeated_first20_pairs.scope: Only pairs drawn from target first20 noncreator buyers; count other launches where both appear in that launch first20, and compare relative order to target sequence.

root_supplied_prior_pool_witness_context.parent_funding_ancestry_interpretation: Parent relayed six target user accounts funded from six distinct intermediate wallets at about 23:06:35Z, and those intermediates funded from six distinct ancestors about one second earlier. Parent has not established a common root owner. The frozen curve-observation prefix begins after that funding window and does not include SOL transfers.

parent_relayed_quote_reserve_snapshot_cl.interpretation: Parent reports authenticated pool quote reserve balances; retained here as parent-supplied RPC context.

root_supplied_prior_pool_witness_context.provenance: The target-side membership below is from this subagent’s frozen successful-observation receipts. The prior pool state/time claims were relayed by the parent agent from its separate RPC investigation; this subagent made no RPC calls and did not independently authenticate those balances. Prior sell signatures/time/logs were read from the already-created witness JSON artifact.

root_supplied_related_address_roles.provenance: Root supplied the paired target addresses and six one-hop funding ancestors from its separate RPC investigation. This subscan only checks their appearances as curve event user/creator, fee payer, or transaction signer within the frozen observations prefix; it does not verify or extend root RPC funding links.

all_target_participants.definition: Every distinct event.user with a successful target buy or sell; includes target creator and sell-only users. Other-mint overlap is counted only if the address makes an outside buy there.

first20_outside_buyers.definition: First 20 distinct noncreator target buy users in (slot, transaction_index, event_index) order.

top20_repeat_outside_buyers.definition: Top 20 noncreator target wallets by distinct buy signatures, then sell signatures, first-buy order, address; each has >=2 distinct target buy signatures. Repeat activity is not a wash label.

temporal_scope.cohort_selection_warning: Target wallet sets use the completed target receipt history and are therefore selected retrospectively. Pre-target wallet appearances are historical, but membership in these sets was not available before each target buy; post-target appearances cannot be causal evidence.
